description: This file defines a React functional component 'EntityUsageExportModal' that provides a user interface for exporting entity usage data in CSV or JSON formats. It incorporates state management for export settings, handles export actions, and renders modal content including filters and controls.

methods.name: EntityUsageExportModal
methods.description: React functional component for export modal dialog with state for export format, scope, and exporting status, handling export actions and rendering modal UI.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Handles the export process based on selected format, manages loading state, and calls appropriate export functions, showing success or error notifications.
